skills.description:
One-shot installer that adds a zero-dependency annotation / markup / commenting layer to
any existing HTML prototype (.html files). Best for design reviews, prototype walkthroughs,
client feedback sessions, and UI handoff — it turns a static HTML file into an annotatable
prototype without the user writing any JavaScript.

Use this skill when the user wants to add annotation, comments, pins, or feedback markers
to an HTML page or prototype.

Trigger phrases (EN / 中文):
- "install annotation", "add annotation to this HTML", "add annotation component",
"给原型装标注组件", "安装标注", "给这个页面加标注", "给 demo.html 加评论功能"
- "在 HTML 上做标记", "原型标注", "给页面加反馈点", "给登录页加批注"

What it installs (auto-initializes on DOMContentLoaded — no manual JS):
- Click anywhere to drop an annotation pin
- Editable popovers with image-paste support (screenshots, mockups)
- Bottom toolbar: navigate / manage / hide / theme picker
- Multi-page support and drag-to-reorder in the manager panel
- localStorage persistence so annotations survive reloads

CSS and JS are embedded in this single SKILL.md — it inlines both directly into the
target HTML, producing a single self-contained file (no external CSS/JS files are
written to disk).
skills.description_zh:
|为任意 HTML 原型一键安装零依赖标注/批注组件，适合设计评审、原型走查、客户反馈、UI 交付。

用法：直接对 AI 说“给这个原型装标注组件”或“给 demo.html 加标注”，它会自动把组件 CSS/JS 注入到目标 HTML 文件。

功能：
- 点击页面任意位置创建编号标注点
- 可编辑气泡，支持粘贴图片（截图、设计稿）
- 底部工具栏：跳转/管理/隐藏/主题切换
- 多页面支持 + 管理面板拖拽排序
- 标注内容 localStorage 持久化，刷新不丢失
- 纯前端实现，无需后端；安装后自动初始化，无需手写 JS
skills.name: HTML原型标注组件
